# tomswallapi_host (Resource)

Constrains a zone to specific addresses on a device's interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_host" "dmz" {
  device    = "fw1"
  zone      = "dmz"
  interface = "eth2"
  addresses = ["192.0.2.128/25"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Owning device.
- `interface` (String) Device interface the addresses are reached through.
- `zone` (String) Zone the addresses belong to.

### Optional

- `addresses` (List of String) Addresses or networks on the interface that belong to the zone.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Make zone membership dynamic so hosts can be added at runtime.
- `exclusions` (List of String) Addresses excluded from the zone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_host.dmz 42
```
